main_text.p: ETiamsi gratia divina, utpote ἀνεξιχνίαςRom. xi. 33. non cadat sub mensuram Geometricè exactam, dantur tamen certæ demonstrationes, ut pro modulo intellectus nostri comprehendere valeamus, τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος, καὶ βάθος καὶ ὕψος, Eph. 3: 18. Nolo autem hîc quibusvis difficultatibus satisfacere, aut quomodo gratia in diversis temporum differentiis sub Promissione, Lege & N. T. diversis gradibus sit dispensata explicare; vulgarissimis tantùm in Remonstrantium causa vexatis insistam; & breviter quidem, tradendo tantùm στοιχεῖα τῆς ἀρχῆς& veluti puerilia rudi-Heb. V, 12[?]menta.
main_text.head: Definitiones.
main_text.p: Geometris & Philosophis arbitrarium est, ideis suis hæc vel illa nomina imponere, nisi quòd usum & consuetudinem sequi tenentur: Theologo autem minor libertas est relicta, verbis enim scripturæ est astrictus, ut loquatur, ὡς λόγια θεοῦ, 1. Pet. 4: 11. Loquar igitur, quantum pote בלשון כנף[?] καὶ διδακτοῖς πνεύματος ἁγίᾳ λόγοις, ut, quæ inde peto argumenta, sint ἀποδείξεις πνεύματος καὶ δυνάμεως 1. Cor. 2: 4.
main_text.head: Postulatum.
main_text.p: Matth. ii. 8.Peto à Lectore, ut ἀκριβῶς distinguere velit inter veritates, quæ pertinent ad τὸ πρέπον τῷ θεῷ, h. e. quod ita Deum decet, ut opposita ipsi sit indecorum, Heb. 2: 10. 7: 26. & inter eas, quæ

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to "Tiamsi" as "ETiamsi". Hebrew line above the text ("עמי עשו") is printed with vowel points that are hard to read at this scan; copied without points. Hebrew word in the Definitiones paragraph ("בלשון כנף") is doubtful. The Heb. reference in the right margin ("Heb. V, 12") has an unclear final numeral. The reference "Matth. ii. 8." sits just above the Postulatum paragraph and is placed as a note at its start. Greek ligatures and accents are transcribed as far as legible. Show-through from the reverse is ignored.
